en.title: Two Virgin Australia pilots report fatigue during Melbourne–Adelaide flight, stood down on arrival
en.summary: Both pilots on Virgin Australia flight VA219 reported fatigue en route from Melbourne to Adelaide and were immediately stood down on arrival; the Boeing 737-800 landed safely, and the case has renewed attention on crew rostering and rest in Australia.
body: A Virgin Australia Boeing 737-800, registered VH-VUX, was operating flight VA219 from Melbourne to Adelaide on Wednesday when both pilots reported fatigue and asked to be stood down on reaching their destination. The aircraft continued to Adelaide and landed safely at 11:05 local time, about an hour after departing Melbourne; it had earlier operated flight VA814 from Sydney to Melbourne that morning. Once in Adelaide, both pilots were immediately offloaded and prevented from operating any subsequent sectors until they were considered fit to return to duty.

The decision followed Virgin Australia's fatigue risk management procedures, which allow pilots to report when tiredness affects their ability to perform their responsibilities safely. Declaring oneself unfit to fly is not an admission of wrongdoing; it is a safety measure designed to prevent potentially impaired crew members from continuing operations. The US Federal Aviation Administration notes that fatigue can reduce concentration, reaction time, memory and decision-making under pressure, and that coffee, medication, motivation and willpower cannot overcome fatigue — adequate sleep remains the most effective solution.

Fatigue management has drawn attention at Virgin Australia before. In May 2024, The Guardian reported that senior pilots had raised concerns about the airline's rostering arrangements, arguing that demanding schedules were contributing to fatigue, with consecutive duty days of 11–12 hours followed by the minimum 12-hour rest period permitted under the applicable rules. Virgin Australia responded at the time that it operated under a robust fatigue management system approved by the Civil Aviation Safety Authority (CASA), and that its pilots received 156 rostered days off annually. Last month, ABC News reported on an Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB) investigation into a taxiway incident at Sydney Airport (SYD) involving Virgin Australia flight 1589 and Qantas flight 420, in which an air traffic controller had a high predicted fatigue risk after being rostered to finish at 8:50 PM and return to duty at 5:30 AM the following morning. The ATSB stressed that a high predicted fatigue level does not necessarily mean an individual is actually fatigued.

zh.title: 維珍澳洲航空兩名機師飛行途中通報疲勞：抵達阿德萊德後立即停飛
zh.summary: 維珍澳洲航空VA219航班兩名機師在墨爾本飛往阿德萊德途中通報疲勞，航班平安降落後兩人立即被解除後續勤務；航空公司依疲勞風險管理程序處理，事件再度引發澳洲機組排班與休息議題。
body: 維珍澳洲航空一架註冊編號VH-VUX的波音737-800客機本週三執行VA219航班，由墨爾本飛往阿德萊德，途中兩名機師通報疲勞，要求抵達目的地後解除勤務。航班平安降落阿德萊德，於當地時間11:05落地，兩名機師隨即被解除後續飛行任務，在確認恢復適航狀態前不得再執行任何航段。該航班約一小時前自墨爾本起飛，飛機當天稍早曾執行VA814航班由雪梨飛往墨爾本。
航空公司依疲勞風險管理程序處理此事，機師可在疲勞影響安全執勤能力時主動通報；申報自己不適航並非承認過失，而是防止身心狀態受影響的機組繼續執勤的安全措施。美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）指出，疲勞會影響專注力、反應時間、記憶與高壓下的決策能力，咖啡、藥物、動機與意志力都無法克服疲勞，充足睡眠才是有效對策。

這並非澳洲航空業首次因疲勞管理受到關注。2024年5月《衛報》報導，維珍澳洲航空資深機師質疑公司排班制度，指出連續11至12小時勤務後僅有法規允許的最低12小時休息；航空公司當時回應稱其疲勞管理系統獲澳洲民航安全局（CASA）核准，機師每年有156天排定休假。上個月澳洲廣播公司報導，澳洲運輸安全局（ATSB）調查雪梨機場一起滑行道事件，涉及維珍澳洲航空VA1589航班與澳洲航空420航班，涉事航管員前晚20:50下班、翌日05:30返勤，預測疲勞風險偏高；ATSB強調預測疲勞偏高不等於當事人實際疲勞。
